dict.string: Daylight reads Time in Daylight, sleep, steps, exercise time, active energy, resting heart rate, heart-rate variability, and respiratory rate. It uses them on this device to show your daylight total and identify which personal patterns are clear. Health data is never uploaded or sold.
Daylight never writes to Apple Health. It requests read-only access for your daylight total and the private Personal Daylight Model.

Daylight uses your approximate location once to work out today's sunrise and sunset so it can show how much daylight is left. The calculation happens on your device and your location is never sent anywhere.
